## Query Parameters

Analytics.js parses optional URL query parameters to trigger Identify and Track calls.

| Parameter             | Effect                                                                                               |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ajs_uid`             | Triggers an Identify call with this userId.                                                         |
| `ajs_event`           | Triggers a Track call with this event name.                                                         |
| `ajs_aid`             | Sets (or returns if queried) the anonymousId.                                                       |
| `ajs_prop_<property>` | Passes a property to the Track call. Requires `ajs_event` to be present; doesn't trigger on its own. |
| `ajs_trait_<trait>`   | Passes a trait to the Identify call. Requires `ajs_uid` to be present; doesn't trigger on its own.   |

## Example

This URL:
```
http://segment.com/?ajs_uid=123456789abcd&ajs_event=Clicked%20Email&ajs_aid=abc123&ajs_prop_emailCampaign=First+Touch&ajs_trait_name=Karl+Jr.
```

Generates these calls:
```js
analytics.identify('123456789abcd', { name: 'Karl Jr.' });
analytics.track('Clicked Email', { emailCampaign: 'First Touch' });
analytics.user().anonymousId('abc123');
```

You can pass up to **one of each trigger parameter** (one `ajs_uid`, one `ajs_event`, etc.).

## Configuration: useQueryString

Control querystring processing with the `useQueryString` option during `analytics.load()`:

**Disable entirely:**
```js
analytics.load('<WRITE_KEY>', {
  useQueryString: false
})
```

**Enable with validation patterns:**
```js
analytics.load('<WRITE_KEY>', {
  useQueryString: {
    aid: /([A-Z]{10})/,   // anonymousId pattern
    uid: /([A-Z]{6})/     // userId pattern
  }
})
```

If a pattern is set, the parameter value must match to be processed.
